sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: glucosinolate-rich brassica profile. Kale brings a brassica-specific phytochemical angle beyond its vitamin bars. Huge vitamin K and carotenoid story. The standout micronutrient identity is the real reason kale scores so strongly. Leafy volume with very low calorie pressure. It adds a lot of plate volume without much energy load.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Cons next: freshness and prep can matter. Older or badly prepared kale can turn tough and bitter fast. Raw texture can be a barrier. The chewy texture makes it less automatic than softer greens. Strong leafy flavour is not universal. It is nutrient-dense, but not an easy flavour win for everyone.
